posts.linkedin:
Many small business owners waste hours creating animated ads with design tools that could be done faster.

Many think that creating an animated ad requires a professional designer or many hours in a design program.

A shop owner in India often opens a design tool late at night to prepare a single Instagram post. They move text, change the font, and export the image in several versions. By the next morning the promotion is already outdated. This pattern is common among cafés, clinics, and small stores that communicate with customers on WhatsApp.

I create short animated videos that small businesses can use on Instagram and Facebook. Each video runs for a few seconds, displays an offer or service with motion and text, and is sized for a phone screen. It can serve as an ad, a reel, or a story. It is not a full website or a long commercial.

First the owner tells me what the business sells and what customers frequently ask about. I then craft an animation based on that information. The owner reviews the draft and requests any changes. Payment is made only after the final video is approved – you pay after approval.

The service is priced at INR 999, INR 1,499, or INR 2,199 per video. This approach helps reduce the time spent adjusting colours, fonts, and layouts for a single post. Once approved, the video can be uploaded immediately, freeing time for answering messages and managing stock. It also makes it easier to showcase an offer on Instagram or Facebook without hiring a video crew.

The service is suitable for owners who want a simple, reusable asset for Instagram and Facebook. It does not replace personal replies to complex customer questions, and it does not guarantee more sales, higher rankings, or any specific results.

If you think this could fit your business, feel free to message me. Payment is required only after you approve the work. DM ADS to discuss further.
posts.bluesky: Myth: animated ads need a designer. A 15-second ready-to-upload video for Instagram and Facebook with your offer, call-to-action, and branding can save your morning. DM ADS to discuss if it fits your business. #SmallBusinessIndia
